chunks: When he said to his people: 'Will you not be mindful of God?'

key_terms.إِذْ: When (referring to a specific time or event)
key_terms.تَتَّقُونَ: You will be mindful / You will fear God (from taqwa)

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Hud say to his people regarding God-consciousness?
ai.summary: This verse captures the prophetic call of Hud (peace be upon him) to his people, the 'Ad, urging them to cultivate *taqwa* (God-consciousness) as the foundation of their spiritual and social reform. In Shia exegesis, this moment highlights the transition from mere monotheism to active moral accountability, serving as a precursor to the divine warnings that followed their arrogance. The phrase underscores the universal prophetic mission of inviting humanity to align their inner states with their outward actions.
